name: dustParams
meaning: the dust trail's parameters, filled by PostLoadInit with Ralph's run-dust values {100, -20, 0xa30, 0xa3, 40, 120, 0} (0x499448-0x499491); passed to Emitter_UpdateDrift every running update

name: dust
meaning: 16-particle dust trail (inline ctor in bipbip_Create 0x499dba-0x499de5); spawns while running (0x499966, spawn 1) and only ages in the tunnel (0x4999f3, spawn 0); drawn by Render while its active bit is set (0x499a27)

name: state
meaning: 0 waiting hidden until Ralph is inside startBox; 1 running along roadPath; 2 on the wall path into the painted tunnel, then Reset when the road path ends (0x49972b-0x499a09)

name: shadowOn
meaning: bit 0: the blob shadow is updated and drawn (Render 0x499d43); set by Reset (0x4995e2), cleared on entering the wall path (0x4998c3)

name: roadPath
meaning: TRAJECTORY: the run along the road, started at SPEED_ONE by Reset (0x4996e3); the bipbip sits at its pos and faces its heading in states 1 and 2

name: wallPath
meaning: TRAJ_WALL: started at SPEED_TWO when the road path reaches its last segment (0x4998f7), with the road's rate; its pos is where the bipbip is drawn in the tunnel

name: speedOne
meaning: SPEED_ONE (s16 of prop +4, 0x49939a): the road path's starting speed

name: speedTwo
meaning: SPEED_TWO (s16 of prop +8, 0x4993ba): the road speed after the first segment and the wall path's speed

name: startBox
meaning: BOX_DECL: Ralph's origin inside it starts the run (0x49976e); set only when BOX_DECL, TRAJECTORY and TRAJ_WALL all resolve (0x4993c7)

name: inTunnel
meaning: 1 in state 2 (0x499973): Render draws the model moved on screen onto the wall path's projected point and pushed back to its depth (0x499a91)
